model.title: Fostering the Use of Technology to Uphold Regulatory Effectiveness in Supervision Act
model.meta: Financial Services Committee · Rep. Marlin Stutzman (R-IN)

summary.text: The bill would require eight federal financial agencies to evaluate their current technological systems and how well they can monitor the institutions they oversee in real time. It would also direct these agencies to review their procedures for buying or building new technology to identify ways to make the process more efficient, and to report their findings to Congress every five years.
